نستعيض (form X)
# نَسْتَعِيضُ (nastaʕīḍu) /nas.ta.ʕiː.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعَاضَ (istaʕāḍa)
# نَسْتَعِيضَ (nastaʕīḍa) /nas.ta.ʕiː.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعَاضَ (istaʕāḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
